release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.1.0

• **Live Synced Lyrics Video Stories & Paused Audio**: Story Studio now generates 9:16 MP4 videos with animated live lyrics & reactive waveform bars paired with song audio starting right from where you paused playback, sharing cleanly to Instagram Stories.
• **Official YouTube Music Videos**: Clicking Music Video now searches YouTube specifically for the official widescreen music video (never static 1:1 album cover art), while keeping highest-quality audio sources for regular listening.
• **My Space in Top-Right Account Icon**: Moved My Space directly into the top-right Account icon on Home (with Account management inside) instead of Settings.
• **Clean Playback Chrome**: Removed remaining Ultra/320k codec pills during song playback across Now Playing and Mini Player.
